name: talkkobold
description: Type text, hear it spoken into a virtual microphone — voice for people who can't talk.
author: TalkKobold

scripts.lint:syntax: for f in src/main.js src/preload.js src/core/tts.js src/core/phrases.js src/core/audio.js src/platform/electron/store.js src/platform/electron/virtualmic.js src/platform/electron/virtualmic.linux.js src/platform/electron/virtualmic.win.js src/platform/electron/icon.js src/platform/electron/window.js src/platform/electron/hotkey.js src/platform/electron/tray.js scripts/gen-icon.js scripts/prep-build.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
